source_visibility: Local unpublished raw recording; retained for reproducibility, not included in the repository.
notes: Only actual continuous screen-recording footage is used between authored intro/outro cards.
All retained footage runs at speed 1. The complete OCR, model decision, and export sequence is retained.
Preset category and boundary rules were reviewed and applied; no meaningful wording edit was made during this recording.
Independent demonstration using original public documents; no government endorsement.
The export ending is a supplementary recording from the same successful split run, with no new inference.
The export supplement retains only 3–9s and 28–35s. Intervening browser navigation, the address bar, and local filesystem paths are excluded.

intro.title:
One packet.
Every document.
intro.subtitle: Real public documents. LiteParse OCR. Jev splitting.

segments.title: 01 / Start with a combined packet
segments.caption: Four complete public documents, combined into one 15-page packet. Original pages are unchanged.

segments.title: 02 / Trace the source documents
segments.caption: The packet combines IRS Form 941, two Treasury auction reports, and a BEA release. Original sources are linked.

segments.title: 03 / Review the category rules
segments.caption: Category descriptions identify tax forms, financial reports, press releases, and legal notices.

segments.title: 04 / Review the boundary instructions
segments.caption: Keep separate Treasury auctions apart. Keep each publication’s continuation pages together.

segments.title: 05 / Read every page, then split
segments.caption: Actual processing at normal speed: LiteParse reads all 15 pages; Jev predicts categories and document starts.

segments.title: 06 / Inspect the recovered documents
segments.caption: Four documents. Jev: 557 ms. Reading: 5.55 s. Full pipeline, including export: 6.27 s.

segments.title: 07 / Inspect the first Treasury report
segments.caption: Packet page 4: the 42-day Treasury bill auction. Its own Financial Report segment.

segments.title: 08 / Preserve the next document boundary
segments.caption: Packet page 5: a different Treasury auction. The same category, with a separate document boundary.

segments.title: 09 / Keep the complete release together
segments.caption: The BEA release remains one document across packet pages 6–15, including its tables and technical notes.

segments.title: 10 / Verify the source pages
segments.caption: Packet page 11 is a statistical table inside the same Press Release segment.

segments.title: 11 / Compare measured decision speed
segments.caption: Saved pilot: Jev 294 ms vs. GPT-5.6 Luna 1.59 s median. One packet, three timed runs per model.

segments.title: 12 / Download the selected document
segments.caption: The selected Treasury report exports as its own PDF. Four PDFs and result JSON are available.

segments.title: 13 / Open the exported PDF
segments.caption: One page, matching packet page 4. The exported PDFs and result JSON accompany this demo.
